intake.evaluation_quarantine_check: No cross-source reference manifests were supplied; evaluation-family membership remains unresolved. Explicit evaluation exclusions must be recorded before any training use.

selection.unit: Lean ConstantInfo of kind theorem owned by selected source modules
selection.method: For each fixed family, select every theorem-kind declaration in the exact-commit upstream compiled inventory; sort names by Unicode codepoint. Include compiler-generated auxiliary theorem constants and retain every selected name after build/export/import failure.
selection.rationale: Both bounded mathematical families have exact-source compiled-object artifacts and deterministic complete declaration inventories. Family choices use compilation availability and closure size; they do not form a probability sample of the repository.
selection.percentage_policy: Report accepted/selected theorem constants and accepted/freshly identified proof declarations separately. Build, import, export and resource failures remain explicit statuses; semantic unsupported counts use actual importer results.

execution.cache_scope: Pinned Lean 4.35 Mathlib dependencies; selected project modules are freshly compiled into isolated directories.
execution.object_reuse_policy: Historical objects and hashes establish provenance. Fresh hosted collection recompiles the pinned source and records new object hashes.
execution.exporter_resource_evidence: GNU time peak resident size and CPU times recorded per command; runner MemTotal/MemAvailable recorded.
execution.kernel_recheck_heartbeat_policy: Each declaration is checked on a fresh dedicated thread with a 2,000,000 kernel-heartbeat limit; allocation-heartbeat and elapsed-time observations are separate counters.

lanes.auxiliary_name_marker_policy: A source-name marker count only; all selected theorem constants remain in the denominator.
